display: Krishna as the Vraja cowherd youth

depiction_rules.notes: Provisional D062 continuity contract informed by mapped chapter photographs; not an approved character master.

visual_bible.face: serene youthful cowherd face consistent with the established Vrindavan youth character contract
visual_bible.build: ordinary youthful human proportions; exactly two attached arms and two attached legs
visual_bible.clothing: yellow dhoti and muted red-orange upper cloth
visual_bible.continuity_markers: deep matte blue skin, yellow dhoti, muted red-orange shawl, plain forehead, one low band and one upright feather; the feather belongs only to Krishna
visual_bible.forehead: plain smooth forehead with no tilak or other mark
visual_bible.headwear: one simple low gold band with exactly one upright peacock feather; no tall crown

never: no more than one upright peacock feather
no duplicate Krishna within a scene
no glossy skin or reflective metallic gold
reference_status: D062 chapter-scoped working contract that applies the established krishna-vrindavan-youth continuity rules; not a separate approved character sheet.
